title: Sheet acquisition parameters
_ownedByCode: A C++ class writes this file and reads its ABSENCE as state. Nothing else may create it: reconcile only adds keys to one that exists.
header: Sheet acquisition parameters. Delete this file to return to defaults.
Every value below is also editable from Teach > Sheet Spec.

fields.description: Rows per sheet when the length is known - an encoder or a fixed repeat. 0 means DETECT the end from the image instead, using the gap settings below. Detection is the general case; a fixed length is the reliable one, and a line that can state it should.
Mean row intensity at or below which a row is GAP rather than sheet
1 when the sheet is brighter than the gap between sheets. 0 inverts that, for a dark substrate running past a bright background.
Consecutive gap rows that end a sheet. Guards against a genuinely dark band inside the printed area being read as the end of one.
A run shorter than this is discarded as noise rather than emitted as a tiny sheet
A run longer than this is emitted truncated and reported: a sheet that never ends means the detector has lost sync, and silently allocating forever is the worse failure.
